summary: Per-frame AI waypoint-following and steering update: computes vehicle speed magnitude, keeps the current waypoint valid (re-querying the spatial tree when drifted), rebuilds the 20-node look-ahead chain on waypoint crossing, dispatches pit-lane entry commands, runs the tire-force solver for grip, classifies a 0..3 speed zone, and projects steering targets clamped to track boundaries. Returns 1 when the update completed or was skipped early.

operations.description: Speed(0x4440) = sqrt(0x34F8^2 + 0x34FC^2 + 0x3500^2) - vehicle speed magnitude from the render-space velocity vector.
If CurrentWaypointPtr (0x4354) is null, resolve it with SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest(dword_5EA2C0, position 0x34E0, WaypointSetSelector 0x4550); return 0 on failure.
If the current waypoint drifted more than 3200 units from position (0x34E0/0x34E8), re-query the nearest waypoint, store it in 0x4354 and set the chain-rebuild byte 0x4488.

Plane test against the waypoint tangent: if dot(v10[5]*(v10[39]-Z) + v10[3]*(v10[37]-X)) < 0 the car passed the waypoint plane - bump the waypoint counter 0x4458 when inside the node radius and set byte 0x4488.
If the chain-rebuild byte 0x4488 is set, rebuild the 20-node look-ahead waypoint chain.
SpatialTreeNearestNeighborSearch(dword_5EA2C0, position, chain base 0x4358, WaypointSetSelector 0x4550, 1) - reselect the current waypoint and store it in 0x4354.
Fill the waypoint chain at 0x4358 with 19 forward links, each step advancing through the node graph keyed on the vehicle node id 0x454C and the chain-node id at *(this+0x4358)+0x12C.

Pit-lane entry dispatch: if the set selector is 0 and the current chain node id equals 1, enqueue AICommandMessageQueueDispatcher(this, 14, WaypointSetSelector) and call sub_4A46F0(this,1,1); if the selector is 1 and the node id is 0, call sub_4A46F0(this,0,0).
Store the current chain node id into WaypointSetSelector 0x4550.
TireForceSolver(wp.grip at 0x70, wp+0x78, wp.traction at 0x74, 16.0) - per-waypoint tire-force reference for the speed/steering model.

Target pace: v18 = chain track distance (*(this+0x4358)+0x48) * 0x4504 + 0x4500, clamped to 75; if WaypointSetSelector(0x4550)==1, v18 = flt_8ACFB4. Write the clamped speed ratio Speed/v18 into 0x4444 (capped at 1.0).
0x4450 = waypoint track distance read from *(this+0x4354)+0x48; then 0x4454 = (int)0x4458 * flt_5EA3FC + 0x4450 - recompute track position from pit exit as a waypoint-counter weighted blend.
Speed-zone classification 0..3 into 0x4468 from Speed thresholds 15 / 30 / 65.
Store the waypoint offset: 0x4498 = pos X, 0x44A0 = pos Z, 0x43F4 = distance to waypoint = sqrt((wp.Z-Z)^2 + (wp.X-X)^2).
Early exit: if no chain rebuild happened and the 0x4140 byte flag is clear, return 1.
Slot-liveness gate: the vehicle-slot id at obj+0x32C8 must not equal 1 before the steering update runs.
Pit-lane waypoint gate: the chain-node pit-entry flag at *(this+0x4358)+0x12C must not equal 1 (the pit-entry command path is dispatched separately).
Steering runs only if the waypoint-chain slot indexed by the speed zone 0x4468 (array base 0x4358) is non-null.
Lateral deviation 0x4428 = -(wp.up.Y * (wp.Z - Z) + wp.up.X * (wp.X - X)) using the waypoint up-vector at *(this+0x4354)+0x20/0x28 and positions 0x34E0/0x34E8.
Blend the zone steering offset: v31 = (1 - speed ratio 0x4444) * 0.15 + chain[zone].heading offset; compute the steering window edges around the zone heading.

If carConditions(0x3D6C) != 2 or FuelLevel(0x3984) > 0.001, apply heading-window clamping: compute the heading difference between chain nodes (headings at *(this+0x4354)+0xB8, *(this+0x4358)+0xB8 and *(this+0x4364)+0xB8 via the pointer 0x4364), wrap to [-pi,pi], and set the steering sign fields 0x4528/0x452C.
Abort steering if the vehicle owner state at deref(this+0)+13000 is not 1.

Compute the three steering targets 0x4414, 0x4418 and 0x441C as line/ray intersections of the waypoint up-vector with the heading rays for the zone-steering, lower-window and current-heading angles (sin/cos projections).

If carConditions != 2 && FuelLevel > 0.001, clamp the steering targets to the track boundaries: scan the 5-node chain for the min/max boundary distances (0x50/0x54) and clamp 0x4414/0x4418 to the resulting interval.
Clear the per-frame processed byte 0x4140.
return 1 - steering update complete.

unresolved: The 13 float globals in the 0x59E43C..0x59E8E0 range and unk_7CE2F0 are read but absent from the raw body; presumed tuning constants consumed by inlined math and TireForceSolver.
Exact semantics of sub_4A46F0 and of the AI command-queue message id 14.

The two packet guards (*(this+0x4358)+0x12C != 1 and obj+0x32C8 != 1) gate the steering path, but their trigger conditions are extracted facts rather than directly readable statements in the decompiled body.
